sentences.text: Divergent is a 2014 American science fiction action film directed by Neil Burger , based on the novel of the same name by Veronica Roth .	Neil Burger	Neil Burger	Divergent	Divergent (novel)	Veronica Roth	Veronica Roth	science fiction	Science fiction film	action film	action film	novel of the same name	Divergent (novel)

The film is the first installment in The Divergent Series and was produced by Lucy Fisher , Pouya Shabazian , and Douglas Wick , with a screenplay by Evan Daugherty and Vanessa Taylor .	Douglas Wick	Douglas Wick	Lucy Fisher	Lucy Fisher	Evan Daugherty	Evan Daugherty	Vanessa Taylor	Vanessa Taylor	Divergent	Divergent (novel)	The Divergent Series	The Divergent Series

It stars Shailene Woodley , Theo James , Ashley Judd , Jai Courtney , Ray Stevenson , Zoë Kravitz , Miles Teller , Tony Goldwyn , Ansel Elgort , Maggie Q and Kate Winslet .	Shailene Woodley	Shailene Woodley	Theo James	Theo James	Ashley Judd	Ashley Judd	Jai Courtney	Jai Courtney	Ray Stevenson	Ray Stevenson (actor)	Zoë Kravitz	Zoë Kravitz	Miles Teller	Miles Teller	Tony Goldwyn	Tony Goldwyn	Ansel Elgort	Ansel Elgort	Maggie Q	Maggie Q	Kate Winslet	Kate Winslet
The story takes place in a dystopian and post-apocalyptic Chicago where people are divided into distinct factions based on human virtues .	post-apocalyptic	post-apocalyptic	Chicago	Chicago
Beatrice Prior is warned that she is Divergent and thus will never fit into any one of the factions .	Divergent	Divergent (novel)
She soon learns that a sinister plot is brewing in the seemingly perfect society .

Development of Divergent began in March 2011 when Summit Entertainment picked up the film rights to the novel with Douglas Wick and Lucy Fisher 's production company Red Wagon Entertainment .	Douglas Wick	Douglas Wick	Lucy Fisher	Lucy Fisher	Divergent	Divergent (novel)	Red Wagon Entertainment	Red Wagon Entertainment	Summit Entertainment	Summit Entertainment
Principal photography began April 16 , 2013 , and concluded on July 16 , 2013 , with reshoots taking place from January 24 -- 26 , 2014 .	Principal photography	Principal photography
Production mostly took place in Chicago .	Chicago	Chicago
Divergent was released on March 21 , 2014 , in the United States .	Divergent	Divergent (novel)
The film received mixed reviews from critics , with praise going towards its concepts and action , and criticism focused on its execution .
Reviewers found the film to be generic and unoriginal , comparing it unfavorably to other young adult fiction adaptations .	young adult fiction	young adult fiction
Despite this , the film was a financial success as it reached the # 1 spot at the box office during its opening weekend .
After its release , the film earned over US$ 288 million worldwide against its budget of US$ 85 million .
It was released on DVD and Blu-ray on August 5 , 2014 .	DVD	DVD	Blu-ray	Blu-ray Disc
A sequel , Insurgent , was released on March 20 , 2015 in the United States .	Insurgent	The Divergent Series: Insurgent
